# montecarlo_aws_collection_data_store (Data Source)

An AWS collection data store is an S3 bucket in your AWS account where Monte Carlo keeps your account's query results, samples and temporary data, so they stay in your storage. Monte Carlo accesses it by assuming a role you create. Registering it completes a deployment provisioned for an AWS data store.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `collection_data_store_id` (String) Id of the collection data store, as returned when it is registered or listed.

### Read-Only

- `authentication_type` (String) How Monte Carlo authenticates when it reaches the data store.
- `bucket_name` (String) Name of the S3 bucket Monte Carlo uses. Empty until it has been registered.
- `created_time` (String) When the data store was created, which is when its deployment was provisioned.
- `deployment_id` (String) Identifier of the deployment this data store belongs to.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether Monte Carlo is using this data store. One that is unregistered, or whose validation failed, is not enabled.
- `external_id` (String) Value to put in the trust policy of the role Monte Carlo assumes to access the bucket. Null before Monte Carlo has generated one, and for a caller who cannot register a data store. Also null if the value could not be read just now, so retry once before treating it as absent.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the data store.
- `last_updated_time` (String) When the data store was last registered, renamed, or given different storage or credentials. Null until one of those has happened.
- `name` (String) Display name of the data store. Null when it has no name.
- `storage_type` (String) Which kind of storage the data store keeps its data in.
